function.name: MEMSETW
function.param: Value to assign to all bytes of that zone
Size in words (1 word = 2 bytes) of the memory zone
function.abstract: It fills a memory zone of size WORDS located in MEM with VALUE

description.p: This advanced function fills a memory zone of size WORDS from value indicated by VALUE. This function is useful to modify graphs of 16 bits with a colour returned by using . We must know that the total size in bytes of the zone, which is filled, is WORDS * 2 because the size of each WORD is of 2 BYTES.
